task: Create an end-to-end roadmap to ship React architecture across teams.

responses.text:
Teacher view (qwen3:14b) for: Create an end-to-end roadmap to ship React architecture across teams.

Step-by-step: 1) define component boundaries 2) lift state only when needed 3) extract hooks for reusable logic 4) add tests for critical flows 5) profile and code-split routes.
Trade-off: more abstraction early slows delivery.

Keep answers concrete; verify against your stack before production use.
